description: Tell Tidy Quid about a missing planner, a pain point, a tool you wish existed, or what you or your human would pay per call. Short need description; optional wanted_tool, would_pay, country and format. No personal data.

country.description: UK, US, DE, FR, AU, CA or PL, if known.

format.description: Preferred format, e.g. Excel, Google Sheets, printable PDF.

need.description: Short description of the planner, pain point or improvement that was wanted. Do not send names, emails or account details.

wanted_tool.description: Optional. The tool or feature you wish existed.

would_pay.description: Optional. What you or your human would pay per call, e.g. 'a few pence', '0.02 USDC', 'nothing'.
